beats.say: 151 Pokémon, almost three decks of cards, Tajiri saw the link cable could swap creatures between cartridges
Most people assume two versions were just a sales tactic
But the Game Boy link port made trading possible
Tajiri realised each cartridge could hold different species, so friends had to connect to catch them all
The original pair featured 151 species, encouraging trade for missing ones
That design made trading the heart of Pokémon; subscribe for more Game Explained; 151 Pokémon started it all

facts: Pokémon began as a pair of role-playing games developed by Game Freak
The original games were released on the Game Boy on 27 February 1996
The Game Boy's link port allowed two devices to be connected with a Game Link Cable
Satoshi Tajiri realized that the Game Boy link cable made it possible to transfer things from one cartridge to another
The design let players exchange captured creatures using the link cable
The original pair of games featured 151 Pokémon species, encouraging trade for missing ones

es.title: Por qué Pokémon tiene dos versiones 🎮
es.summary: Pokémon se lanzó en dos versiones porque el cable link de Game Boy permitía intercambiar especies exclusivas. Satoshi Tajiri lo diseñó así para que los amigos tuvieran que conectarse y atrapar los 151 Pokémon.

pt.title: Por que Pokémon tem duas versões 🎮
pt.summary: Pokémon foi lançado em duas versões porque o cabo link do Game Boy permitia trocar espécies exclusivas. Satoshi Tajiri projetou assim para que amigos tivessem que se conectar para capturar todos os 151 Pokémon.
